user.description: Adds the **Generate description** action to AI Task. It works with any AI Task entity that can generate data.

invalid_response.message: The AI returned a response that does not match the questions: {error}

no_entity.message: No entity_id provided and no preferred AI Task entity set

not_supported.message: AI Task entity {entity_id} does not support generating data

unstructured_response.message: The AI did not return structured data

key.description: Key of the answer in the response. Derived from the question when omitted.
key.name: Key

max.description: Score questions: highest score. Defaults to 10.
max.name: Maximum

min.description: Score questions: lowest score. Defaults to 0.
min.name: Minimum

multiple.description: Choice questions: allow more than one option.
multiple.name: Multiple

options.description: Choice questions: the options to choose from (at least two).
options.name: Options

question.description: The question the AI must answer.
question.name: Question

required.description: Whether the AI must answer. Defaults to true.
required.name: Required

step.description: Score questions: score increment. Defaults to 1.
step.name: Step

generate_description.description: Uses AI to describe the state of entities and devices, and answer questions about it.

devices.description: Devices whose entities' states are given to the AI.
devices.name: Devices

entities.description: Entities whose states are given to the AI.
entities.name: Entities

entity_id.description: Entity ID to run the task on. If not provided, the preferred entity will be used.
entity_id.name: Entity ID

prompt.description: What the AI should describe or decide.
prompt.name: Prompt

questions.description: Questions answered alongside the description. Each has a type: boolean (yes/no), choice (pick from options) or score (number in a range).
questions.name: Questions

generate_description.name: Generate description
